items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Bird Burt was there, and I asked him to come on and go to rehearsal with me.

ctx.x: We are at 1938. This was before Bird. Bird hadn't -- he was still in Kansas City, we hadn't heard anything of Bird then. As a matter of fact, I went to New York around '40 and I lived at the Woodside Hotel. Bird was selling pot. I didn't even know Bird played saxophone. We used to call him the Shadow because Bird would wear this dark cap and this long black overcoat, and he was a man, you know. He sold pot.

So one day I was going to rehearsal with Roy, and Bird Burt was there, and I asked him to come on and go to rehearsal with me. You know, so he went around, allegedly to sell some pot. He -- at this time Joe Eldridge was playing with Roy, Roy's brother. Very good saxophone player. And someone asked Bird Burt, they knew him, and asked him to play. And we never rehearsed. When Bird Burt got through blowing that was just it. I was the most amazed person in the world. I didn't know Bird played the saxophone. I knew…
